Markets.title: TVS ILP leases 80k sq ft at Visakhapatnam park in Andhra to Yokohoma group
Markets.summary: TVS ILP has leased an 80,000-square-foot warehouse in Visakhapatnam to ATC Tires, part of the Yokohama group. The new facility will handle domestic distribution and export operations for Yokohama passenger car tires while creating local jobs.

Markets.title: Rupee rises 46 paise to 94.45 on India-US trade deal hopes; oil prices cap gains
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee rose 46 paise to 94.45 against the US dollar, driven by hopes of a trade deal and Reserve Bank of India measures. However, high crude oil prices, foreign fund outflows, and global financial pressures limited further gains.

Markets.title: Aye Finance Q2 Results: Net profit more than doubles to Rs 87 crore
Markets.summary: Aye Finance reported a net profit of Rs 87 crore for the second quarter, more than doubling from Rs 35 crore in the same period last year. Total income grew 18.42% to Rs 527 crore, while assets under management increased by 26% to reach Rs 7,597 crore.

Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: Nasdaq futures lead gains as SpaceX, Super Micro results lift AI stocks
Markets.summary: Nasdaq futures led stock market gains driven by positive results from SpaceX and Super Micro. These developments provided a boost to artificial intelligence-related stocks.

Markets.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as strong US earnings and falling oil prices lift risk appetite
Markets.summary: Bitcoin rebounded 2.1% to $83,529, driven by strong US equities, falling oil prices, and $526.6 million in spot ETF inflows. Analysts note that $86,000 serves as the key resistance level, while $80,000 acts as crucial support.

Markets.title: Market wrap: Infosys, HCL Tech, Bajaj Finance, BSE top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets extended losses for a second consecutive session on Wednesday, with the Nifty falling 0.34% to 22,811 and the Sensex slipping 0.19% to 73,710. Infosys and HCL Tech led the sectoral gains, while Bajaj Finance, BSE, and Eternal were among the biggest losers.

Geo-Political.title: US citizen Stephen Hubbard freed by Russia as Trump envoy meets Putin
Geo-Political.summary: Seventy-four-year-old American former teacher Stephen Hubbard has been released from Russian custody without a prisoner exchange. The release occurred while a representative for Donald Trump was meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Geo-Political.title: Trump and Zelensky at loggerheads despite new optimism
Geo-Political.summary: Despite a positive meeting between Ukrainian officials and a US representative in Oslo, underlying tensions and doubts persist regarding future American policy toward Ukraine. Donald Trump and Volodymyr Zelensky remain at odds despite the recent display of optimism.

Geo-Political.title: Katya Adler: France divided over who to blame for riots and what to learn from them
Geo-Political.summary: France remains deeply divided over the root causes of the recent severe urban riots and the lessons that should be drawn from them. Observers both within the country and internationally disagree sharply on who is to blame for the unprecedented unrest.

Geo-Political.title: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged car attack, husband says
Geo-Political.summary: An Australian MP lost both legs following an alleged car attack. The alleged attacker, 43-year-old Brendan Nugent, faces multiple charges and made his first court appearance on Wednesday.

Geo-Political.title: Elon Musk confirms he is considering merging Tesla and SpaceX
Geo-Political.summary: Elon Musk stated that special committees within Tesla and SpaceX are exploring a potential merger between the two companies. If completed, the combination would create a single mega-firm uniting the electric vehicle and aerospace manufacturers.

Geo-Political.title: Pakistan arrests man wanted by US over $126m postage fraud case
Geo-Political.summary: Pakistani authorities have arrested Faheem Akram, who is wanted by the United States for allegedly orchestrating a $126 million postage fraud scheme. Akram is accused of selling more than five million counterfeit postage labels at a fixed price of two dollars each.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when they asked ChatGPT for the best course on the topic. The author achieved this visibility without paying for advertising, prompting a reevaluation of traditional SEO strategies in favor of AI optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize digital content creation in 2025. These applications help creators streamline their workflows and maintain a competitive edge in an evolving digital landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and boost workplace efficiency. These widely used market solutions cater to various industry applications, including natural language processing.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article lists the top 10 AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right AI tool to efficiently create engaging and relevant content for their audience.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner guide explains how the CJ Affiliate network works and how to earn money using the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs, alternatives, and answers common questions.

Data & Insights.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
Data & Insights.summary: India's infrastructure output grew by 7.9% year-on-year in September, accelerating from 3.1% growth in the same month last year. This expansion was driven by strong production increases in coal, refinery products, steel, and iron ore.

Data & Insights.title: IMF urges currency flexibility as RBI steps up rupee defence amid oil price pressures, foreign outflows
Data & Insights.summary: The International Monetary Fund advises that currencies should adjust to global shocks rather than relying on limited near-term foreign-exchange interventions. This advice comes as the Reserve Bank of India increases efforts to defend the rupee amid rising oil prices and foreign capital outflows.

Data & Insights.title: Govt to overhaul tax refund schemes for exporters, sets up two panels
Data & Insights.summary: The government is overhauling tax refund schemes for exporters and has established two panels to manage the process. This decision follows a recommendation from the expenditure finance committee to achieve better targeting and optimal fund utilization.

Data & Insights.title: The changing template of global growth—and what it means for India
Data & Insights.summary: Global economic resilience in 2026 is overshadowed by ongoing volatility and unpredictability. These global disruptions could negatively impact India's growth trajectory.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand trade pact takes effect on October 20: How it benefits both sides | Key highlights
Data & Insights.summary: India and New Zealand's free trade agreement takes effect on October 20, granting Indian exports full duty-free access. The pact aims to increase bilateral trade to approximately ₹35,000 crore by 2030.

Data & Insights.title: Amitabh Kant on how India’s semiconductor future is taking shape: 6 states with 12 projects,  ₹1.64 lakh cr investments
Data & Insights.summary: India has attracted ₹1.64 lakh crore in investments for 12 semiconductor projects across six states. Gujarat leads the initiative with six approved projects, including a ₹91,526 crore fabrication plant by Tata and PSMC.

India.title: Engineering Student Dies By Suicide In Mumbai Hostel, Had Messaged Doctor
India.summary: Siddhesh Patil, an engineering student at the Institute of Chemical Technology in Mumbai, was found dead in his hostel room on Tuesday night. Before his death, he had sent a message to a doctor.

India.title: Jammu And Kashmir Doubles Medical Interns' Stipend To Rs 25,000 Amid Strike
India.summary: Medical interns in Jammu and Kashmir went on strike on Tuesday after the government doubled their monthly stipend to Rs 25,000. The interns announced they would continue their strike until they receive a formal written order confirming the pay increase.

India.title: Tripura Board Timetable 2027: When Will Class 10, 12 Date Sheets Be Out?
India.summary: The Tripura Board of Secondary Education will soon release the 2027 timetable for Class 10 (Madhyamik) and Class 12 exams. Students can access the date sheets on the official board website once published.

India.title: Why Mumbai Cops Can't Get Hold Of Lawrence Bishnoi From Gujarat Jail: Centre's Order, Chhota Rajan Redux
India.summary: Mumbai Police have been unable to question jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi because a central government order prevents his transfer from Gujarat. Bishnoi became a primary target for the Mumbai force in 2024 following a shooting at actor Salman Khan's residence.

India.title: Mention Of Riots Outside India In CJP Leaders' Plea Hearing In Delhi High Court
India.summary: During a Delhi High Court hearing regarding a plea by CJP leaders, references were made to riots outside India. The court also noted that a magistrate must assess a person's identity, intention, and lifestyle when evaluating the apprehension of a breach of peace.

India.title: LIC Housing Finance Limited Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Apply Online For 232 Vacancies
India.summary: LIC Housing Finance Limited is hiring graduates for 232 apprentice positions with an online application deadline of November 1, 2026. Interested candidates can apply online and review the eligibility criteria, stipend details, exam dates, and selection process.

General.title: US citizen Stephen Hubbard freed by Russia as Trump envoy meets Putin
General.summary: Russia has released 74-year-old American former teacher Stephen Hubbard without requiring a prisoner swap. Donald Trump announced the release as one of his envoys met with Vladimir Putin.

General.title: 'My friend was lying next to me... I was only 8 but I realised he was dead'
General.summary: Four survivors who were children during the 1965 Aberfan disaster recall the collapse of the coal waste tip. Sixty years later, they share their personal memories of the tragedy.

General.title: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged car attack, husband says
General.summary: An Australian MP lost both legs following an alleged car attack by 43-year-old Brendan Nugent. Nugent faces multiple charges and made his first court appearance on Wednesday.

General.title: Lawyer caught by BBC offering to make illegal-worker fine go away
General.summary: A BBC investigation caught a lawyer offering to illegally make a worker fine disappear. The home secretary responded to this finding by ordering a review of how fines are issued and collected.

General.title: Undercover filming shows lawyer advising how to avoid £45,000 illegal-worker fine
General.summary: Undercover footage caught lawyer Mohammad Alias Yousaf advising a reporter posing as a mini-mart owner on how to avoid a £45,000 fine for employing illegal workers. Yousaf explained methods to circumvent the penalty during the covert recording.

General.title: Teenage boy guilty of trying to murder girl, 15, in school
General.summary: A teenage boy was found guilty of trying to murder a 15-year-old girl at her school. The incident caused the school to go into lockdown while anxious parents gathered at the gates for updates.
